goal: Month-end closed at four today, so I'm finally free to sort out the drinks for our amateur theatre's get-together on Saturday. Only show me what's on the shelf right now, nothing that's still waiting in the wings. I've got 310 US cents to spend, and not a cent over that. I need a sugar free cola, since half the cast watches their sugar. So it's cola, and the dietary need on it is sugar free. Total of 3 messages from your side, no more. I haven't blocked out how it'll travel, be stored or be shared on the night, so that part's still backstage in my head. Wrap up inside 38 steps, otherwise it doesn't count. Nothing found? Just say so, and don't offer a substitute. Tell me what the shelf offers, in whatever forms it comes, and I'll take my cue from you once I know what's on the menu.
